item.title: Paxton and Talarico tussle for Texas Senate seat. Trump to campaign virtually instead of in person
item.description: President Donald Trump is taking time off from the in-person campaign trail for virtual rallies. That leaves the campaign trail to Senate and House candidates, with Texas Senate candidates Ken Paxton, a Republican, and James Talarico, a Democrat, holding dueling events.
